messages:
jared: heads-up — CI started failing on linux-gpu release after landing the attention-kernel reorder. artifacts show a ~22% fatbin size regression and nvlink warnings about mismatched PTX versions. stack trace attached in build logs.

anna: ugh. saw that too on my local reproduce. nvlink warning was: 'ptxas 7.5 unresolved externals / ptx version mismatch'

chetan: what toolkit are we building with in the matrix? we recently bumped to cuda-12.1 images; older PTX in some kernels might be emitting ptx arch that nvlink complains about.

maya: CI matrix is: cuda-11.8, cuda-12.0, cuda-12.1. The problematic build came from the 12.1 runner.

lily: quick thought: are we embedding both PTX and CUBIN across all arch entries (fatbin)? fatbin duplication + debug symbols can blow up size.

jared: yep — the new kernel added multiple specializations which caused nvcc to emit PTX per gencode entry rather than linking to a single compatible PTX. commands from the job:

```
nvcc -o libkernels.fatbin --fatbin -gencode=arch=compute_80,code=sm_80 -gencode=arch=compute_86,code=sm_86 \
  -Xptxas="-v" -lineinfo -O3 -Xlinker --icf-collapse
```

chetan: couple of immediate mitigations:
- gate the release build to only emit CUBIN for supported sm targets and keep PTX for a single minimum arch (reduces duplicate PTX sections)
- separate debug-symbols into a debug package (strip release artifacts)
- add a size-gate job that fails CI if fatbin grows > 10% relative to baseline

maya: agree on size-gate. we should also avoid -lineinfo for release kernels; it inflates size. Keep -lineinfo only on debug builds.

lily: also saw that LTO (if enabled) can drastically change codegen and inline kernels causing size shifts. Are we enabling LTO for the runtime? I thought we disabled for GPU objects.

jared: we don't LTO across .cu in release builds today, but some linker flags slipped in via packaging. build-bot: can you confirm whether LTO was active for that job?

build-bot: CI job 1870001105: gcc flags included -flto on host link step. GPU objects were compiled separately and then linked; nvcc produced fatbin objects, nvlink did not do host LTO but host LTO may have influenced host-side symbol resolution.

chetan: action items proposal:
1) Add a CI job variant that strips PTX and only keeps sm binaries for release (artifact: libkernels.cubin.tar.gz) — owner: chetan
2) Add size regression test keyed by git revision + artifact id, threshold 10% — owner: maya
3) Remove -lineinfo from release nvcc flags; ensure debug builds keep it — owner: lily
4) Audit build matrix gencode list and collapse redundant entries; prefer a minimal PTX generation policy (one PTX for lowest sm we support) — owner: jared

anna: one more: we should pin the ptxas/nvcc version in the build image or explicitly set --ptxas-options to silence/handle versioning differences. nvcc can emit .ptx version tied to toolkit; mixing objects built with different toolkits will trip nvlink.

maya: agreed. for backward compatibility we can also add explicit --generate-line-info vs removing it, but pinning toolchain seems cleaner. I'll add a change to our docker images to make toolkit consistent across matrix.

jared: long-term RFC follow-up: we should define artifact variants for kernels: debug-fatbin, release-cubin-only, compatibility-ptx (single PTX). That lets deployments choose smaller artifacts for production. I'll draft RFC after we get CI mitigations in.

lily: small nit — when stripping, prefer `cuobjdump --dump-section .nv_fatbin` inspection + `nvdisasm` to validate runtime symbols remain. We lost a symbol once due to overzealous strip.

chetan: good call. also let's add a `size-report.json` to artifacts so the size-gate can fail with useful diffs.

jared: timeline: hotfix CI flags today (remove -lineinfo, strip release), add size-gate in 48h, docker/toolkit pin in one week, RFC for artifacts in two weeks. who volunteers for quick PRs?

maya: I'll do the size-gate PR.

chetan: I'll do the nvcc flag cleanup and cubin-only job.

lily: I'll add the strip + validation step and the cuobjdump checks.

anna: I'll help run the local reproducer matrix to confirm fixes across 11.8/12.0/12.1 images.

build-bot: created tasks: #3921 (nvcc flags), #3922 (size-gate), #3923 (artifact strip/validation)

jared: thanks all. let's keep this thread for follow-ups and paste CI links here as we get green builds. :thumbsup:
